rationale: One ATV that would not start on an EVA was restored with a simple fuse swap, reported on the crew's second true day of simulation. The mission brief's ATV triage lesson also lists spare fuses among the items to bring (and the brief's own pre-sim summary includes swapped fuses).
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV §4.1 Technical failures, lines 542-547, 'Lesson for Hypatia III' column; also §1.3 line 72; crew account: SRC-flashline-crew-reports, FLASHLINE-16 DAILY REPORT 08-07-2024 (ATV Repair item, second true day of simulation)
